hypothesis: Two-step attack/concession CEM bank with a KL 2.5 standings-directed warm start improves rare-position estimates
baseline: intended-cell-gated diversified estimator at commit 3d67fb81eb31c78119bb7c39fee341b958c998f9 plus uncommitted gate and benchmark harness
proposal_family: CEMTeamAttackConcession with pure-Q adaptation, independent mixture validation, and frozen production
adaptation: up to two 300-sample CEM batches for each of the four highest-priority directional tails; all charged to discovery
decision: inconclusive as a tuning lead; do not promote to default production
reason: CEM improved the existing diversified baseline modestly, but rare-band precision and complete-matrix coverage remained below equal-work plain MC. A 20-seed confirmation would be required before accepting a future revision.
legacy_benchmark: The older 20-seed CEM family benchmark failed its own matched scout/frontier check at seed 1008 on the current group-16982 database export, so it was not used as evidence.
